text: Handling deadlines well requires good planning and clear communication. First, time management is essential: create a realistic schedule and break large tasks into smaller steps. Second, prioritization helps you focus on the most important work first, so you do not waste time on low-value tasks. Third, scope management means being honest about what you can finish. If a task is too big, reduce it or agree on a new plan early. Finally, communicate openly with your team or manager. If you see a problem, speak up before it is too late. These habits reduce stress and help you meet deadlines more reliably.
